captions.text: It was in June 1975 that I decided to resign from the post of president of MADECH, on the one hand because it seemed to me that this movement could now manage very well without me, and on the other hand because I thought I had committed an error in structuring this association according to the law of 1901, thereby likening this movement, so crucial for humanity, to a friendly society of petanque players or war veterans…
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: It seemed necessary to me to create a movement more in accordance with the fantastic message the Elohim had transmitted to me, that is, a movement respecting to the letter what was advised by our creators, namely geniocracy, humanitarianism, the renunciation of all deistic religious practices, and so on.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: An association of the 1901-law type was by definition in opposition to the message, at least in the form in which we had structured it, since there was a vote of all the members and therefore no respect for geniocracy, which would have required that only the most intelligent members be able to take part in decisions.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I therefore had to repair this error at the highest level, without however abolishing MADECH but on the contrary transforming it, while awaiting more effective modifications from the point of view of its structures, into an association of support (for which the 1901-law regime was not troublesome) to the true movement I was going to create with the most open members of MADECH who wished it: the congregation of the guides of MADECH.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: This undeclared association bringing together people wishing to open the minds of men to the infinite and to eternity and, by scrupulously applying what was asked in the message, becoming guides for humanity.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: In this society seeking by all means to close minds with deistic religions, soporific education, anti-thought television programmes and narrow political battles, I was therefore going to try to form, through an initiation, people who could set out on the roads of the world to attempt in their turn to open minds.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: MADECH thus became an organism of support, of first contact with people discovering the message, and retained all its importance.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: In a way, MADECH became a support movement composed of practitioners and the congregation of guides was going to be a movement composed of monks guiding the practitioners.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I knew there were people quite capable of directing MADECH among the members and I had confirmation of this during the elections to the administrative council.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: My replacement at the post of president, Christian, was a physicist of promise and the rest of the council was composed of persons just as representative and competent.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: It was also in the month of June that François, one of the most devoted members of MADECH and also one of the most open, came to see me at Clermont-Ferrand.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I made known to him my desire to find a house in the countryside, in as withdrawn a corner as possible, in order to rest a little and to be able to write tranquilly a book in which I would recount all that had happened to me before 13 December 1973, before anyone might recount just anything about my past.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: He told me he had a farm in a lost corner of the Périgord and that, if the place pleased me, I could go and spend a month or two there and even stay as long as I wished, for no one lived there.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: We therefore set off very quickly by car to visit the place and, before the calm and the serenity of the region, I decided to go there for two months.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: At the end of a fortnight I liked it there so much that I began seriously to think of settling there definitively.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: François came to join us at the end of July and we began to envisage my move for the day after the meeting of 6 August at Clermont-Ferrand.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I was not yet quite decided, being afraid of failing my mission a little by moving away from the place of my marvellous encounter, but on 31 July, while we had gone out to take a little fresh air with my companion, Marie-Paule, and François, we saw an apparently enormous but silent craft evolving in jerks almost above the house, sometimes at unimaginable speeds, then instantaneously immobile and advancing in saw-teeth at about five hundred metres from us.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I was very happy that other people were with me to witness this spectacle and a sensation of indescribable happiness then invaded me.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: François told me his hair had stood up on his head from emotion.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: For me, it was an evident sign of the agreement of the Elohim for me to settle in this region.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: The next morning I noticed that I had on my arm, on the biceps, near the bend of the elbow, a strange mark.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I did not immediately make the connection with the apparition of the day before, but subsequently many people told me it could only be a mark made by them.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: It was a red circle about three centimetres in diameter and five millimetres thick, inside which were three smaller circles.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: This mark remained the same for about a fortnight, then the three circles in the middle transformed into a single one, which gave two concentric circles.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Then at the end of about a fortnight the two circles disappeared, leaving on my arm a white spot which I still have.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I insist on the fact that I never suffered from this mark and that I did not feel the slightest itching during all the time I had it.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Certain open-minded scientists to whom I showed this mark put forward the hypothesis that it could be a sampling carried out by means of a perfected laser.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: The meeting of 6 August finally took place as planned in the crater of the Puy-de-Lassolas and there reigned during this gathering an admirable harmony and fraternity.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I had decided on this assembly of the members of MADECH on this date without quite knowing why, but in fact the Elohim had guided me, for members informed me, on the day of the gathering, that it was day for day the thirtieth anniversary of the explosion of the Hiroshima bomb, and also the day of a Christian feast: the Transfiguration.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Chance, the imbeciles will say.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: After this gathering, members of MADECH helped me to move and I therefore settled completely in the Périgord.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: On 7 October, towards eleven o'clock at night, I suddenly wanted to go out to look at the sky.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I dressed warmly, for it was rather cool, and I began to walk in the dark.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Without realizing it I took a very precise direction and I suddenly felt the need to go to a corner that François had shown me during the summer, a deserted place, situated between two streams, surrounded by forests and called the Roc Plat.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I arrived at this place towards midnight, wondering a little what I had come here to do, all the while following my intuitions since I had been told I could be guided telepathically.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: The sky was magnificent and the stars shone everywhere, indicating that there was not a single cloud.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I began to watch the shooting stars when, suddenly, the whole countryside lit up and I saw an enormous ball of fire, like a spark, appear behind the bushes.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I advanced towards the place where this ball of fire had appeared, filled with an immense joy, for I was more or less sure of what I was going to discover.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: The same craft I had seen on six occasions in the month of December 1973 was there, before me, and the same being I had met two years earlier then approached me with a smile full of benevolence.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I noticed at once a single difference: he no longer had the spacesuit which made, the first time, like a halo around his face.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I was marvellously happy, after all this time spent trying to make the world understand that I was indeed telling the truth, to see again the one who was responsible for the upheaval of my life.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I bowed before him and he spoke:
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Stand up and follow me.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We are very satisfied with you and with all that you have done for two years.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is now time to pass to the next stage, for you have proved to us that we could trust you.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: These two years were, in fact, only a putting to the test.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You can notice that today I have no protection around the face and that my vehicle appeared to you all at once and was not equipped with flashing lights.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: All that was destined only to reassure you by appearing to you under aspects corresponding to the image one generally forms of a traveller of space.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But now you have evolved sufficiently no longer to be frightened, so we no longer use these approach techniques!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: On penetrating behind him into the craft I could observe that everything was similar interiorly to the one I had known at my first encounter: walls having the same metallic aspect as the exterior, no instrument panel or instrument, no porthole and a floor made of a translucent blue material on which were placed two armchairs made of a transparent material recalling a little, without having its disagreeable touch, inflatable plastic armchairs.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: He invited me to sit down in one of the two armchairs, settled into the other and asked me not to move any more.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: He then pronounced a few words in an incomprehensible language and it seemed to me I felt the craft sway slightly.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Then all at once I felt a sensation of intense cold, as if my whole body were transforming into a block of ice, better, as if thousands of crystals of ice were penetrating into all the pores of my skin, down to the marrow of my bones.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: This lasted very little time, a few seconds perhaps, and I felt nothing more.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Then my interlocutor rose and said:
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: You may come, we have arrived.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: I followed him down the small stairway.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: The apparatus was immobilized in a circular room of metallic aspect about fifteen metres in diameter and about ten metres high.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: A door opened and my guide told me to enter, to undress completely and that I would then receive other directives.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I penetrated into a new circular room without the slightest angle which must have been about four metres in diameter.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I undressed and a voice told me to penetrate into the room which was before me.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: At that moment a door opened and I entered another room similar to the one where I had left my clothes but long and making one think a little of a corridor.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: All along this corridor there were lightings of different colours under which I passed successively.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: The voice then told me that by following the arrows painted on the floor, I would arrive in another room where a bath awaited me.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: In the following room, I found indeed a bathtub set into the floor.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: The bath was lukewarm, just right and discreetly perfumed.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: The voice then advised me to satisfy my natural needs, which I did; then I was asked to drink the contents of a glass situated on a small shelf near the metallic wall.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: It was a white liquid deliciously perfumed with almonds and very cool.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Then a kind of very soft pyjama, seeming to be of silk, was proposed to me.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: It was white, very close-fitting and awaited me on another shelf.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Finally a last door opened and I found my guide again; he was accompanied by two beings similar to him but whose features were different while being just as welcoming.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I rejoined them in a vast hall where all was but wonderment.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: It was arranged on several levels and must have had in all about a hundred metres of diameter.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: It was entirely covered by an absolutely transparent dome, so transparent that it did not seem evident at first sight that there was a dome.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Thousands of stars studded the black sky and yet the whole hall was lit as in full day by a soft light of natural aspect.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: The floor was covered with furs and long-piled carpets of breathtaking and enchanting colourings.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Everywhere works of art each more admirable than the last, and certain ones with changing and animated colours; elsewhere, bright red plants and others blue as beautiful as exotic fish but several metres high.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: An ambient music made of sounds approaching the organ and the musical saw with sometimes choirs and basses of extraordinarily gripping vibrations made the flowers bow in rhythm and the colours change according to the style of the score.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Each time someone spoke, the music became softer so that one could make oneself understood without being hindered and without having to raise the voice.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Finally, the air was perfumed with a thousand scents which also changed according to the music and the place where one found oneself.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: The hall divided into about ten corners, separated by different levels, which each had a particular character.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: A streamlet meandered in the middle of all this.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: My guide, for whom his two friends seemed to have much regard and respect, then said to me:
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Follow me.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We are going to settle comfortably for I have many things to tell you.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: I followed him to a set of armchairs and sofas of very soft black fur where the four of us settled.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: My guide then spoke:
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I am going to give you today a second message which will complete the one I dictated to you in December 1973.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You have nothing to take notes with, but do not be afraid, all that I am going to tell you will remain engraved in your mind, for here we have a technical means for you to remember all that you are going to hear.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: First of all we wish to congratulate you for all that you have done for two years, but also to forewarn you that the rest of your mission will perhaps be more difficult.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But, in any case, never be discouraged for you will be rewarded for your efforts whatever happens now.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: To begin, a passage of the message must be rectified which you transcribed badly concerning an eventual intervention on our part to destroy humanity.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It must be made quite clear that we will not intervene.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Humanity is now arriving at a turning point of its history and its future depends now only on itself.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If it knows how to master its aggressiveness towards itself and towards the environment in which it finds itself, it will attain the golden age of interplanetary civilization, in universal happiness and blossoming.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If, on the contrary, it lets itself go to violence, it will destroy itself by itself either directly or indirectly.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: There is no scientific or technical problem insurmountable for human genius, on condition that human genius be in power.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A being with a deficient brain can threaten world peace as a being of genius can bring it happiness.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The faster you put geniocracy in place, the faster you will suppress the risks of cataclysm due to beings with a little-evolved brain.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In case of a cataclysm destroying humanity, only the people who follow you will be saved and will have to repeople the devastated earth when all danger is set aside, as already happened at the time of Noah.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This is what Buddhism explains, in saying that at the moment of death the soul of the dying one must be sufficiently vigilant to escape the numerous demons, failing which it would reincarnate, thus falling back into the cycle, whereas if it succeeds in escaping these famous demons it escapes the cycle, attaining the state of beatitude through awakening.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In fact, it is a very good description which applies not to the individual but to humanity entire which must resist the demons which can make it fall back into the cycle each time it is in a position to choose; these demons are aggressiveness against one's fellows or against the nature in which one lives, and the state of beatitude through awakening is the golden age of civilizations where science is at the service of men, the terrestrial paradise where the blind can see and where the deaf can hear scientifically.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The fact of not having been sufficiently wary of the demons entailing the fall towards 'reincarnation', towards a new slow progression from the state of primitive towards that of an evolved people, in a hostile world, with all that this entails of sufferings.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is for this that in our emblem figures the svastika or gammadion cross which one finds in numerous ancient writings and which signifies the cycle.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is the choice between paradise, which a pacific use of science permits, and the hell of a return to the primitive stage, where man undergoes nature instead of dominating it to profit from it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This is, in a way, a natural selection, on the cosmic scale, of the species capable of escaping their planet.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Only those who perfectly master their aggressiveness can attain this stage.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The others self-destruct as soon as their scientific and technological level permits them to invent weapons powerful enough for that.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This is why we never fear the beings who come from elsewhere to contact us.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Thousands of contacts have confirmed this absolute rule in the universe: the beings capable of escaping their planetary system are always pacific.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When one is capable of escaping one's planetary system that means one has also escaped the progression-destruction cycle due to a lack of mastery of aggressiveness at the moment of the discovery of the most important sources of energy which precisely permit envisaging voyages outside one's own system, but which can also permit fabricating offensive weapons with irreversible destructive powers.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: To go in this direction, your region of the terrestrial globe, France, which is already on the good path in trying to make Europe, ought to be the first country without an army.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It would thus become an example for the whole world.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Its career military men would lay the bases of a European peacekeeping army, while awaiting the transformation of this into a world peacekeeping army.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Instead of being guardians of war, the military would thus become guardians of peace, a title meriting infinitely more respect.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is necessary that an important country show the road to follow to the others, and it is not because France would no longer have obligatory military service and would put its career military men at the service of the Europe it is trying to construct that the neighbouring countries would invade it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: On the contrary, that would bring them very quickly to follow the path traced by your country by imitating it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Once military Europe is realized, there would remain only to realize economic Europe by creating a single European currency.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Then, the same process would be to apply for the whole world by adding, as we have already told you in the first message, a single world language which would become an obligatory language in all the schools of the earth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If one country must show the way, France must be that one.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is by advocating a force of dissuasion that one accumulates the weapons of one's own destruction.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Each one wishing to dissuade someone (one practically never knows whom) an unfortunate gesture then risks transforming the force of dissuasion into a force of intervention, fatal for everyone.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is in thinking of the past that men see the future.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This is an error.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: One must scoff at the past and build the present for the future, instead of building the present on the past.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Understand well that it is barely thirty years since the men of the most evolved countries are no longer quite primitives.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You are only just emerging from it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And there are millions of people who are still, on earth, primitives and who are incapable of seeing something in the sky without seeing in it a divine manifestation…
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You know moreover that the deistic religions are still very strong in all the countries little evolved economically.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: One must not have the cult of the ancients but that of intelligence, while seeing to it that the old have an agreeable life.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Our distant ancestors not only must not be respected, but must be shown as an example of poor narrow primitives who did not know how to open themselves to the universe and who only knew how to transmit, from generation to generation, very few worthwhile things.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The more primitive a people is, the more the deistic religions flourish there.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This is moreover maintained by the visitors come from other planets, who have only this means to visit tranquilly worlds which have not yet dominated their aggressiveness.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If you arrive soon at this stage of evolved visitors of primitive worlds, you will yourselves be forced to use this system, very amusing moreover, which consists in passing oneself off as gods in their eyes.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This is moreover extremely easy, for, for the primitives, as soon as one comes from the sky one can only be divine…
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: One must all the same lay it on a little in order to be respected and agreeably received, which spoils nothing.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We continue moreover on earth to make apparitions in order to see if it still takes and what are the reactions of the public powers, the governments and the press.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We often amuse ourselves a great deal…
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: As we have already explained to you in the first message, there is no god and obviously no soul.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: After death, there is nothing if science does nothing so that there be something.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: As you know, it is possible to recreate a dead being from a cell of this being for it contains the physical and intellectual plan of the being of which it is part.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It has been observed that a being loses a few grams at the moment of its death; in fact it is only the energy of which every living being disposes, which eliminates itself at that moment.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And as you know, energy is, like matter, heavy.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You also know that we have discovered that on the infinitely small there is organized intelligent life, very certainly as evolved as we and comparable to what we ourselves are; that we have been able to prove.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Starting from there we have discovered that the stars and the planets are the atoms of a gigantic being, which itself certainly contemplates other stars with curiosity.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is also quite possible that the beings who live on the infinitely small of the infinitely large being and its fellows have known periods when they believed in an immaterial good god.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You must understand well that all is in all.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: At this moment in an atom of your arm, millions of worlds are being born and others are dying, believing or not in a god and a soul and while a millennium elapses, the gigantic being of which the sun is an atom has had only the time to take one step.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Time is in effect inversely proportional to the mass or rather to the level of the form of life.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But all in the universe is living and is in harmony with the infinitely large and the infinitely small.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The earth is living, like all the planets, and, for the little mould that is humanity, it is difficult for you to realize it because of the time lag due to the enormous difference of mass which prevents you from capturing its palpitations.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: One of our red corpuscles or, better, one of the atoms forming our body could not either imagine that it forms with its fellows a living being.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Finally each one matters little, the universal equilibrium is constant but if we wish, at our level, to be happy, we must live in harmony with the infinitely large, with the infinitely small and with our fellows.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: No argument seeking to support the existence of any god, or of a soul, stands up as soon as one glimpses ever so little the infinite of the universe.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: There could not be the slightest paradise in any place since, the universe being infinite, it cannot have a centre.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: On the other hand I explained to you previously that there cannot be any communication by reason of a difference of mass too great, creating a difference in the flow of similar time between an infinitely large entity and a universe of infinitely small entities.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Finally, if one can imagine an immortal soul escaping from the body after death, an image very poetic but a little naive since issued from the brain of primitives, one cannot conceive a place where it would go given the infinite of the universe.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This quantity of energy, which flies off at the moment of death, scatters in a disordered fashion and mixes with all the energies in suspension in the ambient air, losing all identity; this identity which is obviously engraved in ORGANIZED matter, in the cells of the living being which has just died.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This matter which has organized itself according to the plan which the genes of the male and the female defined, at conception, in forming the first cell.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Some might say concerning the origin of life on earth your explanation changes nothing since you cannot say what there was at the beginning, a stupid question which proves that the person who poses this question has not taken consciousness of the infinite which exists in time as in space.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: There is neither beginning nor end to matter since nothing is lost, nothing is created, all is transformed, as you have certainly already heard; only the forms can change according to the will of those who attain a scientific level permitting them to realize that.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is the same with the infinite of the levels of life, this is what the second part of our emblem represents, the star of David composed of two triangles interlocked one in the other, which means that which is on high is like that which is below.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: With the svastika or gammadion cross, which signifies that all is cyclic, in the middle of the six-branched star, you have our emblem which contains all the wisdom of the world.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You can moreover find these two symbols assembled in ancient writings like the Bardo Thödol or Book of the Dead of Tibet and many others still.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is obviously very difficult for a finite human brain to take consciousness of the infinite, which explains this need to limit the universe in time and in space by beliefs in one or several gods whom one renders responsible for everything.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In effect the beings who do not arrive at a sufficient level of humanity facing the universe, can with difficulty admit the infinite which makes of man not something exceptional, but some being situated at some period in some place of the infinite universe.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Man obviously prefers things well defined, well delimited, bounded in a way in the image of his brain.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Those who ask themselves whether it is possible that there be life on other planets are the finest example of these bounded brains, and the comparison you made during one of your lectures of these people with frogs which, at the bottom of their pond, would ask themselves if there is life in the other ponds, pleased us very much.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You could very quickly live in a veritable terrestrial paradise if the technology of which you dispose at present were put at the service of the well-being of people instead of being only at the service of violence, of armies, or of the personal profit of certain ones.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Science and technique can totally liberate men not only from the worry of hunger in the world, but also permit them to live without obligation to work, the machines being well able to charge themselves with the daily tasks all alone thanks to automation.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Already, in your most modern factories, whereas not so long ago several hundred persons were needed to fabricate a car, one person suffices who simply watches a computer which commands and realizes all the operations of fabrication of the car.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And in the future, this single person will even be able to be suppressed.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Then the workers' unions are not content for the factory has less and less need of personnel and lays off more and more people.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This is what is abnormal.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: These fantastic machines which do the work of five hundred persons must permit these five hundred persons to live instead of serving to fatten a single person: the boss.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: No man must be at the service of another nor work for another against a salary.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The machines can well do the chores and charge themselves with all the work, permitting man to consecrate himself to the only thing for which he is made: to think, to create, to blossom.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This is what exists with us.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You must no longer raise your children according to these three old primitive precepts: work-family-fatherland, but on the contrary according to the following: blossoming-liberty-universal fraternity.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Work has nothing sacred when it is motivated by nothing other than the necessity of earning the wherewithal to live painfully, it is even terribly debasing to sell oneself, thus to sell one's life in order to be able to eat by effecting work which simple machines can do.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The family has always been only a means, for the ancient and modern slavers, to oblige people to work harder for a chimerical family ideal.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Finally the fatherland is still only a supplementary means to create a competition between men and to bring them with more ardour every day towards sacrosanct work.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: These three terms, work-family-fatherland, have moreover always been supported by the primitive religions.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But you are no longer primitives now!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Shake off all these dusty old principles and profit from life on this earth which science can transform into paradise!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Do not let yourselves be enrolled by those who speak to you of an eventual enemy to permit armament factories to make badly paid workers work building destructive weapons in bringing profits to big industrialists!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Do not let yourselves be had by those who speak to you of denatality taking on a horrified air because the youth has understood that one must not have too many children, that it was better to have few so that they be happy, for not too numerous on the earth; do not let yourselves be had by those who brandish once again under your nose the neighbouring peoples who, they, multiply and could become menacing!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: These are the same who are partisans of the accumulation of atomic weapons under pretext of dissuasion…
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Finally, do not let yourselves be had by those who tell you that military service permits learning to use a rifle and that it can always serve all the while piling up nuclear missiles; they want to teach you violence, to teach you not to be frightened of killing a man like yourself under pretext that he wears another uniform, to make it so that this becomes for you a mechanical gesture, by dint of manoeuvres against training targets.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Do not let yourselves be had by those who tell you that one must fight for the fatherland!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: No fatherland merits it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Do not let yourselves be influenced by those who tell you: And if enemies invade our country must one not defend oneself?
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Reply to them that non-violence is always more efficacious than violence.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is not proved that those who are dead for France were right whatever the aggressiveness of the aggressor.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Look at the triumph of Gandhi in India.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They will tell you that one must fight for one's liberties but they forget that the Gauls lost the war against the Romans and that the French are no worse off for being descendants of the vanquished having benefited from the civilization of the victors.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Live rather in blossoming, liberty and love instead of listening to all these bounded and aggressive beings.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The most important accessory you have to help you attain a durable universal peace is television, veritable planetary consciousness, which permits seeing what happens each day at all points of the globe and realizing that the barbarians who live on the other side of the frontier have the same joys, the same sorrows and the same problems as oneself, of observing the progress of science, the latest artistic creations, and so on.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: One must obviously take care that this marvellous organ of diffusion and communication does not fall into the hands of persons using it to condition the crowds by orienting the information.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But you can truly consider that television is the nervous system of humanity, which permits each one to take consciousness of the existence of others, to see them live and which thus avoids forming, on their account, false ideas which bring a fear of the foreigner.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: There was once the fear of the neighbouring tribe, then the fear of the neighbouring village, of the neighbouring province, of the neighbouring state, there is currently a fear of the neighbouring race, and if this no longer existed there would be the fear of eventual aggressors come from another planet…
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: One must on the contrary be open to all that comes from elsewhere for all fear of the foreigner is the proof of a primitive level of civilization.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In this sense, television is irreplaceable and is one of the most important stages if not the most important of all civilization, for it permits, as well as radio, all these isolated cells of humanity that men are, to be at all moments informed of what the others do, exactly as the nervous system does in the body of a living being.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But you are no doubt wondering where you find yourself.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You are currently in a base situated relatively near the earth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In the first message you noted that we moved seven times faster than light, this was true twenty-five thousand years ago when we landed on the earth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Since then we have progressed much and we now travel in space much faster still.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It takes us only a few instants to effect the journey we put nearly two months to cover at that epoch, and we continue to progress.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If you will kindly follow me we are now going to effect a little voyage together.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: I rose and followed my three guides.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: We crossed an airlock and I discovered in an immense hall a craft similar to the one which had made me come from the Earth to here, but much bigger.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: It must have had a dozen metres of exterior diameter and there were inside four seats instead of two, placed also face to face.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: We sat down as the first time and I felt anew the same sensation of intense cold, but this time it lasted much longer, about ten minutes.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Then the craft swayed slightly and we directed ourselves towards the exit hatch.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I could discover a marvellous, paradisiacal landscape, and I find in fact no qualifier to describe the enchantment procured by the vision of immense flowers, each more beautiful than the last, in the midst of which strolled unimaginable animals, birds with multicoloured plumage, pink and blue squirrels with the heads of bear cubs climbing in the branches of trees bearing enormous fruits at the same time as gigantic flowers.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: At about thirty metres from the craft, a little group of Elohim awaited us, and I could discover behind the trees a set of constructions harmonizing perfectly with the vegetation and resembling shells of vivid colours.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: The temperature was very mild and the air perfumed with a thousand scents of exotic flowers.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: We walked in the direction of the summit of a hill and the panorama which began to appear to me was marvellous.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Innumerable streamlets meandered in a luxuriant vegetation and far off an ocean of azure shimmered in the sun.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: On arriving in a clearing, I discovered with stupefaction a group of men similar to me, I mean men similar to those who live on Earth and not Elohim.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Most were nude or clad in robes made of multicoloured silks.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: They bowed respectfully before my three guides then we all sat down in armchairs apparently cut in the stone and covered with thick furs but which, despite the heat, always remained very cool and agreeable.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Men coming out of a minuscule cavern situated just beside us approached, carrying trays crumbling under fruits, grilled meats accompanied by sauces each better than the last and accompanied by drinks of unforgettable perfumes.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: And always, behind each guest, two of the men who carried the dishes held themselves crouched, ready to satisfy the slightest desires of those who were taking refreshment.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: These asked them, moreover without paying attention to them, what they desired.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: During the meal, a marvellous music, come I know not from where, had made its appearance and young women with lines as sculptural as those of the servers had set themselves to dance, nude, with an incomparable grace, on the surrounding lawn.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: There must have been about forty guests similar to the men of the Earth in addition to my three guides.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: There were Whites, Yellows, Blacks, men and women and all spoke a language I did not understand and which resembled Hebrew.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I was seated at the right of the Eloha I had met two years earlier and at the left of the six other Elohim.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Facing me was seated a young bearded man, very handsome and very slim, with a mysterious smile and a regard full of fraternity.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: At his right held himself a man with a noble face sporting a long beard very thick and very black.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: At his left there was a more corpulent man with an Asiatic face.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: He had the skull shaven.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: My guide, towards the end of the meal, began to speak to me:
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: In my first message I had spoken to you of a residence found on our planet where men of the Earth were maintained in life thanks to the scientific secret of eternity from a cell, and among whom were found Jesus, Moses, Elijah, etc. This residence is in fact very big since it is a planet entire where also live the members of the council of the eternals.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: My name is Yahweh and I am the president of the council of the eternals.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: On the planet where we are currently live at this moment eight thousand four hundred Terrans, having attained during their life a level of opening of mind on the infinite sufficient or having permitted terrestrial humanity to move away from its primitive level by its discoveries, its writings, its way of organizing society, its acts exemplary by their fraternity, their love or their disinterestedness, and on the other hand the seven hundred Elohim members of the council of the eternals.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Whatever the rest of your mission, you have your place reserved here, among us, in this veritable little paradise where all is easy thanks to science, and where we all live happy and eternally.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: I do say truly eternally for, as on earth, we have created here all life and we begin to comprehend perfectly the life of the infinitely large, that is to say of the planets, and we can detect the signs of ageing of the solar systems which will permit us to leave this planet to create another paradise elsewhere as soon as we have anxieties as to its survival.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The eternal Terrans or Elohim who live here can blossom as they wish without having anything else to do than what pleases them, scientific research, meditation, music, painting, etc. or nothing at all if they have the desire!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The servants you saw carrying the dishes a while ago, as well as the dancers, are only biological robots.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They are in fact fabricated according to the same principle we used to create the men of the Earth, in a hundred percent scientific manner, but they are voluntarily limited and absolutely submitted to us.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They are on the other hand incapable of acting without one giving them the order and very specialized.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They have no aspiration of their own and no pleasure save certain ones whose specialization requires it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They age and die like us, but the machine which fabricates them can produce of them largely more than we need.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They are on the other hand incapable of suffering, of sentiments, and cannot reproduce by themselves.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Their duration of life is similar to ours, that is to say, thanks to a small surgical intervention, about seven hundred years.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When one among them must be destroyed because too old, the creative machine produces of them one or several others according to our needs.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They come out of the apparatus ready to function and having their normal size for they have neither growth nor childhood.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They know how to do only one thing, obey the men and the Elohim and are incapable of the slightest violence.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They are all recognizable by the small blue stone they wear, men and women, between the eyes.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They occupy themselves with all the low tasks and do all the work which presents no interest.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They are produced, maintained and destroyed in the basement where, moreover, all the maintenance work is effected by these robots and by enormous computers which regulate all the questions of nourishment, of supply of raw materials, of energy, etc. We each have on average about ten at our service and as we are a little more than nine thousand Terrans and Elohim, there are about ninety thousand of them permanently, men and women.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Like the Elohim members of the council of the eternals, the eternal Terrans do not have the right to have children and accept to undergo a small intervention which renders them sterile, but this sterility could easily be annulled.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This disposition has for goal to avoid that beings not meriting it come to mingle in this marvellous universe.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: On the other hand the eternal men and women can unite freely as it seems good to them and all jealousy is suppressed.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: On the other hand, the men who desire to have one or several companions outside the relations of equality which exist between eternal men and women or who do not want to live with a woman on a plane of equality, can have one or several biological robot women absolutely submitted and to whom the machine gives exactly the physique one desires.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is the same for the women who can have one or several biological robot men absolutely submitted.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The machine producing these robots gives the entity it fabricates exactly the physique and the specialization one desires.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: There exist several types of ideal women and men from the point of view of forms and physiognomies, but one can modify as one wishes the size, the measurements, the form of the face, etc. One can even furnish the photo of a being one has, for example, admired or loved on earth, and the machine produces for you the exact replica of it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Thus the relations between eternals of the two sexes are much more fraternal and respectful and the unions between them are marvellously pure and elevated.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Given the extraordinary level of opening of mind of the beings admitted here, there are never any problems between them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The majority passes almost all its time meditating, making scientific researches, artistic compositions, inventions and creations of all sorts.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We can live in different cities of multiple architectural styles in very varied sites which we can moreover modify at our pleasure.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Each one blossoms as he wishes by doing only what gives him pleasure.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Some find pleasure in pursuing scientific experiments, others in making music, others in creating ever more astonishing animals, others in meditating or in doing nothing other than love while enjoying the multiple pleasures of this paradisiacal nature, drinking at the innumerable fountains and eating the succulent fruits which grow a little everywhere at all moments.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Here, there is no winter, we all live in a region comparable to your equator, but, as we can act scientifically on the meteorology, it is always fine and not too hot.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We make the rain fall at night when we wish and where we wish.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: All this and many other things you cannot comprehend in one time make of this world a veritable paradise.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Here, each one is free and can be so without danger for all merit this liberty.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: All the things which create a pleasure are positive, on condition that this pleasure effectively harms no one.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This is why all the sensual pleasures are positive, for sensuality is always the opening on the exterior world, and all opening is good.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You are only just emerging, on Earth, from all these primitive taboos which wanted to make appear bad all that touches sex or nudity whereas, whatever the cases, it is what there is of the most pure.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: What more disappointing for your creators than to see people say that nudity is something bad! nudity, the image of what we have made!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: As you can see, here everyone is nude and those who wear clothes do so because these clothes are works of art offered by certain other eternals, who made them with their hands, or out of concern for elegance and decoration.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When a Terran is admitted into the world of the eternals, he undergoes first a course of chemical education so that here nothing surprises him and he understands well where he is and why.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: My guide, Yahweh, interrupted himself an instant then resumed:
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: You are currently seated just facing the one who, two thousand years ago, was charged with creating a movement destined to diffuse more widely the message we had left to the people of Israel, a diffusion which was to permit you to be understood currently.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is a question of Jesus whom we were able to recreate from a cell we had preserved before his crucifixion.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The handsome bearded young man seated just facing me addressed to me a smile full of fraternity.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: At his right is found Moses, at his left Elijah, at the left of Jesus is seated the one whom, on Earth, one remembers under the name of Buddha.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A little further you can see Mohammed in whose writings I am called Allah for he did not dare to name me out of respect.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The forty men and women present at this meal are all beings representative of the religions created following our contacts on the Earth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And they all looked at me with very fraternal and amused faces, certainly recalling their own surprise at their arrival in this world.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: My guide continued:
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Now I am going to show you some of our installations.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He rose and I followed him.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: He invited me to put on a very wide belt ornamented with an enormous buckle.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: He and his two friends had buckled the same kind of ornament.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Immediately I felt myself lifted from the ground and carried, at about twenty metres above the grass, level with the tops of the trees, at a very great speed, perhaps a hundred kilometres an hour, perhaps more, in a very precise direction.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: My three companions were with me; Yahweh in front and his two friends behind.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Curious thing (among others…)
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I did not at all feel the wind whip my face.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: We set ourselves down in a little clearing, very near the entrance of a little grotto.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: We were in fact still carried by our belts but only at a metre from the ground and went much less fast.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: We crossed galleries with metallic walls and arrived in a vast hall in the middle of which an enormous machine was surrounded by about ten robots recognizable by their frontal ornament.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: There we resumed contact with the ground and removed our belts.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Yahweh then spoke:
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Here is the machine which produces the biological robots.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We are going to create for you one of these beings.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He made a sign to one of the robots, situated near the machine, and the latter touched certain parts of the apparatus.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Then he made a sign to me to advance near a glass about two metres long by one metre wide.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In a bluish liquid, I then saw the form of a human skeleton draw itself vaguely.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Then this form drew itself more and more clearly to become finally a veritable skeleton.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Then nerves drew themselves and formed on the bones, then muscles and finally skin and hair.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A splendid athlete was now lying there where a few minutes earlier there was nothing.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Yahweh spoke:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Recall in the Old Testament this description in Ezekiel:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Son of man, can these bones live?… there was a noise, and behold a shaking… there were upon (the bones) the sinews, and the flesh came up, and he covered them with skin above… the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The description you are going to make is certainly very close to that of Ezekiel, apart from the noise which we have been able to suppress.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Indeed, what I had seen corresponded perfectly to the description of Ezekiel.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Then, the lying figure had slid towards the left and disappeared completely from my sight.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Then a hatch opened and I saw again the creature whose creation in a few minutes I had witnessed, lying on a very white fabric.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He was still immobile, but suddenly he opened his eyes and rose, descended the few steps which separated him from our level and, after exchanging a few words with another robot, advanced towards me.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: There, he held out to me his hand which I shook, and I could feel his skin soft and warm.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Do you have on you the photo of a dear one?
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Yes, I have the photo of my mother in my wallet, which has remained in my clothes.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He showed it to me asking me if it was indeed this one.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: As I acquiesced, he gave it to one of the robots who introduced it into the machine and touched a few parts of the apparatus.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Before the glass, I witnessed a new fabrication of a living being.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Then when the skin began to cover the flesh, I noticed what was in the process of being produced: one was in the process of fabricating an exact replica of my mother, after the photo I had furnished…
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Indeed, a few instants later, I could embrace my mother or rather the image of my mother such as she was ten years before for the photo I had furnished dated from about ten years.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Yahweh said to me:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Now allow that one make for you a very small puncture in the forehead.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: One of the robots advanced towards me and, with the help of a very small apparatus resembling a syringe, made me a puncture in the forehead which I did not even feel so light was it.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Then he introduced this syringe into the enormous machine and touched other parts of the apparatus.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Anew a being was in the process of forming under my eyes.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: When the skin covered the flesh, I saw another me draw itself little by little.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Indeed, the being which came out of the machine was an exact replica of myself.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Yahweh said to me:
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: As you can observe, this other yourself does not wear on the forehead the small stone which characterizes the robots and which the replica of your mother wore.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: From a photo we can make only a replica of the physique, with a psychic personality null or almost, whereas from a cell like the one we took from you between the eyes, we can realize a total replica of the individual from whom we took this cell, with his memories, his personality, his character, etc. We could now send back to Earth this other yourself and no one would notice anything.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We are going immediately to destroy this replica for it is of no use to us.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But at this moment there are two of yourself listening to me, and the personalities of these two beings begin to be different, for you know you are going to live and he knows he is going to be destroyed.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But this does not bother him for he knows he is only yourself.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This is again a proof, were one needed, of the non-existence of the soul, in which certain primitives believe, or of a purely spiritual entity proper to each body.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We then quit the room where this enormous machine was found, then, by a corridor, we entered another hall where other apparatuses were found.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: We approached another machine.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: In this machine are contained the cells of the malevolent beings who will be recreated to be judged when the time has come.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: All the beings who, on Earth, advocated violence, wickedness, aggressiveness, obscurantism, those who, although having all the elements in hand to understand whence they came, did not know how to recognize the truth, will be recreated to undergo the chastisement they merit after having been judged by those whom they made suffer or by their ascendants and descendants.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You have now well merited a little rest.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This robot will serve you as guide and will furnish you all that you desire until tomorrow morning; there we will have still a few words to say to each other and we will accompany you back to the Earth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You are going to have between now and then a foretaste of what awaits you when your mission will be finished on your planet.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: I then saw a robot advance towards me and salute me respectfully.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: He was very tall and very handsome, dark and with a beardless and athletic face.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: The robot asked me if I wanted to see my chamber and after my agreement, held out to me a belt serving to displace oneself.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I found myself anew carried above the ground and, when I resumed contact with it, I was before a house resembling more a Saint-Jacques shell than a habitation.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: The interior was entirely upholstered with long-piled furs and an immense couch, big as at least four terrestrial beds, and as if hollowed in the ground, was recognizable only by a colour different from the furs covering it.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: In a corner of the immense room, an immense bathtub, hollowed at ground level and big as a swimming pool, was installed between vegetals of marvellous forms and colours.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Do you desire companions? asked the robot.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Come, you are going to make your choice.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I put my belt back on and I found myself transported before the apparatus serving to fabricate the robots.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: A luminous cube appeared before me.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: One made me sit down in an armchair facing this cube and one held out to me a helmet.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: When I was settled, a magnificent brown young girl, of marvellously harmonious dimensions, appeared in the luminous cube in three dimensions.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: She moved to put herself in value and if she had not been in a cube floating a metre above the ground, I would truly have believed she was real.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: My robot asked me if she pleased me and if I wished that she have different forms or a modified face.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I told him I found her perfect.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: He answered me that it was a question of the ideal woman aesthetically speaking or rather of one of the three types of ideal woman defined by the computer in function of the tastes of the majority of the residents of the planet, but that I could ask all modifications which would give me pleasure.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Before my refusal to modify anything whatever of this magnificent creature, a second woman, blond and heady that one, appeared in the luminous cube, different but just as perfect as the first.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: There either I found nothing to modify.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Finally a third young person, more sensual than the first two and red-haired that one, appeared in the strange cube.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: The robot asked me if I desired to see other models or if these three ideal types in my race would suffice me.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I answered obviously that I found these three persons extraordinary.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: At that moment a magnificent black woman appeared in the cube, then a Chinese woman very fine and slender, then a young voluptuous oriental woman.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: The robot asked me which person I desired to have for companion.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: As I answered him that all pleased me, he advanced towards the machine fabricating robots and spoke an instant with one of his fellows.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Then the machine set itself in motion and I understood what was going to happen.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: A few minutes later, I was back in my residence with my six companions.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: There, I took the most unforgettable of the baths I have ever taken in company of these robots of charm absolutely submitted to all my desires.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Then, my robot guide asked me if I had the desire to make music.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: He took out, before my affirmative response, a helmet similar to the one I had put on before the projection of the feminine robot models.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: The robot asked me: now think of the music you would like to hear.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: At once a sound corresponding exactly to the music I was thinking of made itself heard and, as I constructed a melody in my head, this one became reality with sounds of an amplitude and a sensitivity more extraordinary than all those I had ever heard.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: The dream of every composer had become reality: to be able to compose directly musics without having to pass through the laborious work of writing and orchestration.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Then my six adorable companions set themselves to dance to my music a bewitching and voluptuous dance.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Finally at the end of a moment, my robot asked me if I desired also to compose images.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Another helmet was held out to me and I settled myself before a half-circle screen.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I then set myself to imagine scenes and these scenes became visible on the screen.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: It was, in fact, an immediate visualization of all the thoughts which could come to me.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I set myself to think of my grandmother and she appeared on the screen, I thought of a bouquet of flowers and it appeared; if I imagined a rose with green polka dots, it appeared.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: This apparatus permitted in fact visualizing instantly one's thought without having to explain it.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: What a marvel.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: My robot said to me:
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: With training one arrives at creating a story and making it unfold.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Many spectacles of this kind, spectacles of direct creations, take place here.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Finally, at the end of a moment, I went to lie down and passed the maddest night of my existence with my marvellous companions.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: The next day, I rose and took again a perfumed bath, then a robot served us a delicious breakfast.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Then he asked me to follow him for Yahweh awaited me.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I put my carrying belt back on and I soon found myself before a strange machine where the president of the council of the eternals awaited me.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: It was less important than the one which created robots but all the same very big.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: In its middle there was a large embedded armchair.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Yahweh asked me if my night had been agreeable, then he explained to me:
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: This machine is going to awaken in you certain faculties which are in sleep.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Your brain is going to be able to exploit all its potential.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Sit down here.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: I settled myself in the seat he designated to me and a kind of shell enveloped my skull.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I had the impression of losing consciousness an instant then it seemed to me that my head was going to burst.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I saw multicoloured flashes pass before my eyes.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Finally all stopped and a robot helped me to descend again from the armchair.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I felt myself terribly different.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I had the impression that all was simple and easy.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Yahweh spoke:
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: From now on we will see by your eyes, we will hear by your ears and we will speak by your mouth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We will even be able to heal by your hands - as we already heal at Lourdes and in many other places of the world - certain sick ones who, according to our judgement, merit that we do something for them because of their will to make radiate the messages we have given you and of their efforts to acquire the cosmic spirit by opening themselves on the infinite.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: All men, we observe them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Immense computers ensure a permanent surveillance of all the men living on the Earth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A mark is attributed to each one in function of his actions during his life, according to whether he has walked towards love and truth, or towards hate and obscurantism.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When comes the hour of the assessment, those who walked in the good direction have right to eternity on this paradisiacal planet; those who, without being wicked, did nothing positive are not recreated; and as for those who were particularly negative, a cell of their body is conserved which will permit us to recreate them, when the time has come, so that they be judged and undergo the chastisement they merit.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You who will read this message, tell yourself well that you can have access to this marvellous world, to this paradise; you will be welcomed there you who will follow our messenger, Raël, our ambassador on the path of universal love and cosmic harmony, you who will help him realize what we will ask of him, for we see by his eyes, we hear by his ears and we speak by his mouth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Your idea of creating a congregation of guides of humanity is very good.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But be severe as to their selection so that our message be never deformed or betrayed.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Meditation is indispensable to open the mind, but asceticism is useless.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: One must enjoy life with all the force of one's senses for the awakening of the senses goes hand in hand with the awakening of the spirit.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Continue if you wish, and if you have the time, to do sport, for all the sports and games are good, whether they develop the musculature or, better still, the mastery of self like the automobile or the motorcycle.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When a being feels alone, he can always try to communicate telepathically with us, all the while trying to be in harmony with the infinite; he will feel from it an immense well-being.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: What you advised concerning a regrouping of people who believe in us in each region on Sunday morning towards eleven o'clock is very good.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Few members do it currently.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The mediums are useful, seek them out, but balance them for their gift of mediumnity (which is only a gift of telepathy) unbalances them and they set themselves to believe in the supernatural, in magic and other things one cannot more stupid, like the belief in an etheric body, a new way of trying to make believe in a soul… which does not exist!!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They set themselves in fact really in rapport with people having lived several centuries ago and whom we have recreated on this paradisiacal planet.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: There is an important revelation you can make from now on: the Jews are our direct descendants on the Earth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is for this that a particular destiny is reserved for them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They are the descendants of the sons of Elohim and the daughters of men of whom it is question in Genesis.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Their original fault was to have united themselves with their scientific creation; it is for this that they have suffered so long.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But for them the time of pardon has arrived and they will now be able to live tranquil in their recovered country unless they commit a new fault in not recognizing you as our envoy.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We wish that our terrestrial embassy be edified in Israel on a territory which the government will give you.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If they refuse, you will be able to construct it elsewhere and Israel will undergo a new chastisement for not having recognized our envoy.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You must consecrate yourself uniquely to your mission.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Be not anxious you will have the wherewithal to make your family live.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The people who believe in you and therefore in us must help you.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You are our messenger, our ambassador, our prophet and you have in any case your place retained here among all the other prophets.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You are the one who must assemble the men of all the religions.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For the movement you have created, the Raelian Movement, must be the religion of religions.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: I insist, it is well and truly a religion, but an atheistic religion as you had already understood.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And you are our ambassador, our prophet; those who will help you we will not forget them, and those who will make troubles for you we will not forget them either.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Have no fear and fear no one for whatever happens you have your place among us.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And shake a little those who lose confidence!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Two thousand years ago one threw into the lions' pit those who believed in Jesus, our envoy; today you risk what? the irony of the imbeciles? the sniggers of those who have understood nothing and who prefer to hold to their primitive beliefs?
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: What then is all that in relation to the lions' pit?
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: What then is all that in relation to what awaits those who will follow you?
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In truth, it is easier than ever to follow one's intuition.
